title: Funny AI Images: 12 Pictures and Their Prompts
summary: 12 funny AI images made in Flick, each with the prompt behind it: animals in human jobs, everyday disasters and absurd scale. Copy one and make your own.
body_markdown:
### How do I make a funny AI image?


Describe one ordinary scene, the one thing that goes wrong in it and someone reacting to it, ask for a realistic photo, then generate it with an image model and adjust one detail at a time until the joke is clear.


### What are some funny AI image ideas?


Good funny AI image ideas include animals in human jobs, such as a corgi lifeguard or a goat office manager, everyday disasters, such as a collapsing birthday cake, and absurd scale, such as a hamster the size of a house.


### What should a funny AI image prompt include?


A funny AI image prompt should name the subject, the one thing that goes wrong, a detail that gives the joke away, a reaction in the frame, an everyday setting with its light, and the mood in plain words such as funny and warm.


### Can I make a funny AI picture of my own pet?


Yes. Upload a photo of your pet to Flick and describe the funny scene you want, such as your dog working as a barista, and the image model keeps your pet's look while it builds the scene around it.


### Why do my funny AI images come out creepy?


AI images turn creepy when the faces, light or mood are left open, so name the tone in plain words such as funny and warm, ask for a realistic photo in friendly daylight and keep the joke to one clear thing.


### Is it free to make funny AI images?


Yes, you can start free: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and one image from GPT Image 2.6 costs 5 credits at its default settings.


### Can I turn a funny AI image into a video?


Yes. Use the image as the start frame of an image to video model and describe what happens next, such as the goose catching up with the postman, to make a short funny clip.
